keywords.name: Scout X
keywords.text: When an effect instructs you to “Scout X,” reveal X cards from the top of your skill deck. You may prepare one of those cards (place it faceup under your hero card). Then, place each of the remaining revealed cards on the top or bottom of your skill deck in any order.

keywords.name: Strike X
keywords.text: During your attack test, you may discard a card that has the “Strike X” keyword to add X hits to the attack.

keywords.name: Guard X
keywords.text: When you or a hero in your space would suffer damage or fear, you may discard a card that has the “Guard X” keyword to prevent any combination of X damage and fear.

keywords.name: Sprint X
keywords.text: During your turn, you can discard a card that has the “Sprint X” keyword to move X additional spaces. You can perform actions between each movement.

keywords.name: Rest X
keywords.text: At the end of your turn, you can discard a card that has the “Rest X” keyword to discard any combination of X of your facedown damage or fear cards

keywords.name: Hide X
keywords.text: After performing a test, you can discard a card that has the “Hide” keyword to gain a “Hidden” boon card.

modifiers.name: Pierce
modifiers.text: This attack ignores the enemy’s armor.

modifiers.name: Smite
modifiers.text: This attack ignores the enemy’s sorcery.

modifiers.name: Sunder
modifiers.text: This attack permanently reduces the enemy’s armor by one (before hits are applied).

modifiers.name: Cleave
modifiers.text: Each enemy in the group suffers the full number of hits.

modifiers.name: Lethal
modifiers.text: If this attack reduces the enemy’s current health by at least half, the enemy is defeated.

modifiers.name: Stun
modifiers.text: This attack exhausts the enemy group. If the group is elite, it also cannot counterattack this attack.

space_traits.name: Darkness
space_traits.text:
During the darkness step of the shadow phase, each hero that is in darkness suffers an amount of fear indicated by the app.
(Typically 2 fear, Spirit negates.)

space_traits.name: Difficult Ground
space_traits.text: When a hero moves into a space with difficult ground, that hero can discard one prepared card. If they do not discard a card, they cannot move out of that space this turn.

space_traits.name: Fortified
space_traits.text:
A hero cannot move out of a fortified space if there are more enemy figures than hero figures in that space, including the hero who is moving.
An enemy group cannot move out of a fortified space if there are more hero figures than enemy figures in that space, including the enemy group that is moving.

cards.background_en: The Dunedain of the North were nearly destroyed. Although their number is few, they continue to watch and guard the lands that were once their kingdom. At their bead is their Chieftain, Aragorn, descendant of Isildur, a Man destined for greatness. The prophecies and lineage serve him little in this time, bowever. Bloodlines cannot stop a foe's blade, and songs of future glory do not feed one's people. Though years of peace and prosperity may come, these are no such years. Now is a time of trials, bardship, and survival. New dangers threaten the North in ever greater number, and darker years are yet to come.
cards.background_ru:
Дунэдайн Севера были почти уничтожены. Хотя их число невелико, они и по сей день продолжают охранять земли, которые когда-то были их королевством. Их предводитель — Арагорн, потомок Исильдура и человек, обречённый на величие.
Однако в это трудное время его происхождение и пророчества о его судьбе мало чем могут помочь. Кровь предков не защитит от вражеского клинка, а песни о будущей славе не накормят голодных. Хоть время мира и процветания может когда-нибудь настать, сейчас всё иначе. Сегодняшний день — это время испытаний, трудностей и выживания. Всё больше опасностей угрожают Северу, а значит, тёмные годы ещё впереди.

cards.background_en: Arwen Undomiel, face as fair as that of Luthien, fate as grand as that of Beren, carries the legacy of her ancestors forward. She, like her father Elrond before her, possesses the talent to see the threads of futures woven together. She holds both past and future like clear water cupped in her hands. Her words carry great wisdom for those who listen to ber advice. However, the future is not yet set in stone, and seeking to guide it toward the ligbt will lead Arwen away from her people and out of her forest. The dangers she goes to confront are many, but wherever she goes she will be the Evenstar of the Elves, bringing light and wisdom to all.
cards.background_ru:
Арвен Ундомиэль, прекрасная, как Лутиэн, и великая, как Берен, продолжает наследие своих предков. Как и её отец Элронд, она обладает талантом видеть тесно сплетённые нити будущего. Будущее и прошлое перед ней как на ладони. Её слова несут великую мудрость для тех, кто прислушивается к её совету.
Однако будущее всегда пребывает в движении, и стремление направить его к свету уводит Арвен прочь от своего народа и родного леса. Ей предстоит столкнуться со множеством опасностей, но куда бы она ни отправилась, она всегда будет оставаться Вечерней Звездой эльфов, несущей всем свет и мудрость.

cards.background_en: On his many journeys through the long years, Balin has never met a challenge that dissuaded him for long. The darker the path, the more treasures that might lay hidden from view, only waiting for the brave and the clever to uncover them. After Balin successfully reclaimed Erebor with Thorin's company, the Dwarves thrived. But Balin hungered for new adventures, and new discoveries. Now, Balin is ready to make another journey, perhaps even into the darkened halls of Khazad- dum that were abandoned so long ago. The lost treasures there tempt him to delve deeper than he ever bas before, and he yearns to see a king sit upon the throne under the Misty Mountains again.
cards.background_ru:
За время своих многочисленных странствий Балин никогда не сталкивался с таким вызовом, который заставил бы его отступить. Чем темнее путь, тем больше сокровищ может скрываться от глаз в ожидании тех храбрецов, которые отважатся за ними спуститься. С тех пор как Балин вместе с Торином отвоевали Эребор, гномы процветают. Но Балин жаждет новых приключений и новых открытий.
Теперь Балин готов к следующему путешествию, возможно, даже в мрачные чертоги Казад-Дума, которые уже давно заброшены. Затерянные в них сокровища манят его спуститься глубже, чем когда-либо, и он хочет снова увидеть короля, восседающего на троне под Мглистыми горами.

cards.background_en: As a Ranger of the North, Beravor knows the bidden roads of Middle-earth, through barren hills, tangled wood, and unquieted ruins. These secret paths are her frequent course, gifting both safety and speed through otherwise perilous lands. Nothing can cause this Ranger to stray but the call for aid from the imperiled, whether ally or stranger-and no matter the cause, no matter the danger, she is ready for the fight. In a time when the dark expanse between the lands of the Free Peoples is ever growing, the swiftness, knowledge, and valour of Beravor are coveted qualities that many will soon require.
cards.background_ru: Беравор, следопыт Севера, знает все потайные тропы в бесплодных холмах, густых лесах и непроходимых руинах Средиземья. Она часто пользуется этими тайными маршрутами, чтобы быстро и безопасно преодолеть гибельные земли. Ничто, кроме просьбы о помощи от страждущих, не заставит её сойти со своего пути. И будь то союзник или незнакомец, сколь бы ни была велика опасность, Беравор готова сражаться. Сейчас, когда Тьма всё больше распространяет своё влияние на земли свободных народов, многим могут пригодиться такие качества Беравор, как стремительность, ум и доблесть.

cards.background_en: Not many years ago, Bilbo travelled east from the Shire and it changed him forever. He is not entirely different, still enjoying warm food, polite company, uninterrupted rest, and holes in the ground that contain neither Goblin nor Dragon- —-nor riddling, murderous creatures, for that matter. At his core, however, something has altered. He is now a wanderer, burglar, warrior, and, though he dare not tell his neighbours, adventurer. He has sprung into action and fled for his life. He has sheathed a bloodied blade, fown with Eagles, and stood atop the wealth of kingdoms. Ihat Tookish part, now awoken, does not easily lay back to rest. It may be time for another adventure.
cards.background_ru: Несколько лет назад Бильбо путешествовал на восток от Шира, и тот поход навсегда изменил его. Нет, он по-прежнему ценит горячую еду, вежливую компанию, долгий отдых и норы в земле, в которых нет гоблинов, драконов, а также кровожадных существ, любящих загадки. Однако глубоко в его душе что-то поменялось. Теперь он странник, взломщик, воин и искатель приключений, хотя о последнем он до сих пор не решается рассказать своим соседям. В конце концов, Бильбо смог выжить. Он окроплял свой клинок кровью врагов, летал на орлах и стоял на вершине груды королевских сокровищ. Пробудившуюся в нём кровь Туков нельзя так просто успокоить. Возможно, настало время для нового приключения.

cards.background_en: Boromir, eldest son of the twenty-sixth Steward of Gondor, Denethor Il, loves his land with the burning ferocity of dragon-fire. As a young and rising star of Gondor's army, he has gained glory and respect on the battlefield. As a son and a brother, he would do anything to aid his family. But Gondor faces dark times ahead, and the people look for more than just a soldier in him. He must become a hero who can save not only Gondor, but all of Middle-earth, and prove that there is still hope and valour in the line of Mardil the Steadfast, who swore the first Steward's oath to keep Gondor safe until the King returned.

cards.background_en: Many a weary traveller on the road bas been comforted and cheered at the end of the day by the sight of a small cookfire and a friendly face ready to share a story. But very few Hobbits would prefer a dusty campfire to a proper stone hearth. Calaminth Took is the exception. She has wandered far from the Shire, through Bree, and into the wild lands beyond in search of the kinds of legends told by firelight. Everywhere she goes, she brings the comforts that Hobbits hold dear, and all who share her fire count themselves lucky. But for any who see only a soft wanderer in her guise, a warning: a Took can wield a ladle or a mace with equal ferocity.

Her own brother, Ihorin Oakenshield, and ber two sons, Fili and Kili, were all. slain recapturing Erebor. As the last surviving member of her family, and one of the greatest smiths of the mountains, Dis cannot justify letting others do the much-needed work any longer. It is time for her to take the best of ber craft and all of her years of cunning and bring them to bear against the foes of Middle-earth. Let those who stand against ber beware: a Dwarf does not rest until the battlefield is empty.

cards.background_en: After residing in Erebor and seeing the Dwarves prosper, Dwalin feels called to venture into the wider world for one more great adventure. He knows that the gathered wisdom of many kingdoms could bring even more wealth and progress for the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain. Though, perhaps it is the ancient anger that all Dwarves hold in their hearts that drives Dwalin to leave his mountain home in favor of a battlefield of Orcs. The years have taken their toll on Dwalin's combat prowess, but his courage in battle has not diminished with time. Surely, whethey he pursues the thrill of war or greater wisdom, Dwalin will prove a valuable ally in any quest. SUCCESTED START Lorekeeper" Role "Spear" and "Cloak

cards.background_en: As a noblewoman of Gondor, Eleanor is familiar with the endless work of defending seitled lands from the enemy. As soon as she came of age, Eleanor took to the roads, carrying messages between remote villages in the mountains. Every year, it seems, more Orcs threaten the border and more brave soldiers fall to the foes cursed weapons, never to rise again. But Gondor is not the only land threatened by growing evil, and Eleanor is a woman ready to see the wider world. She bopes to return someday to Gondor, her beloved land between the mountains and the sea, with better ways to protect her people from the enemy.
cards.background_ru: Элеанор принадлежит к аристократии Гондора и знает, каково это — без устали трудиться, чтобы защитить свои земли от врага. Достигнув необходимого возраста, Элеанор сразу занялась доставкой сообщений между отдалёнными деревнями в горах. Она видела, что с каждым годом всё больше орков стекается к границам и всё больше храбрых воинов гибнет под ударами их проклятого оружия. Однако Гондор не единственная земля, которой угрожает растущее зло, а Элеанор вполне созрела для того, чтобы повидать свет. Она надеется когда-нибудь вернуться в Гондор, на свою возлюбленную родину, зажатую между горами и морем, и принести с собой наилучший способ защитить свой народ от врага.

cards.background_en: Born in the great port city of Mithlond, Elena has watched for years as hosts of ber kin take to the sea, retreating toward the Undying Lands. Even the population of her own city begins to dwindle, with Elves of every age and vocation, save for the shipwrights, disappearing westward. Nothing remains for her in these forsaken lands but the beauty of this fading. As the blazing glory of the setting sun or the climactic splendor of a final chorus, so is the passing of the Elves. Having gathered the stories and songs of those who fled west, Elena now sets out to seek the tales of those who remain and perhaps, if she is fortunate, partake in one of her own.
cards.background_ru: Рождённая в большом портовом городе Митлонд, Елена годами наблюдала за тем, как предки её народа отплывают к Бессмертным Землям. Даже население её города постепенно стало сокращаться, по мере того как эльфы всех возрастов и профессий, за исключением корабелов, отправлялись в плавание на запад. В этих покинутых землях Елене осталось лишь любоваться красотой постепенного угасания. Подобно пылающему величию заходящего солнца или великолепию кульминационных нот мелодии, исход эльфов вдохновлял Елену. Собрав рассказы и песни тех, кто устремился на запад, она возжелала услышать истории тех, кто остался, и, возможно, если ей повезёт, стать участником одной из таких историй.

Freahild is one of their number, trained as a youth to defend Rohan from all the enemies who seek to threaten its borders. Perbaps as famous as the Shieldmaidens, the fine horses of Rohan are bred to be swift and strong and agile. Freahild has trusted Snowbright, one of the finest mounts Rohan has to offer, to cary her safely across torn battlefields and storm-swept plains for years. cards.background_en: Gandalf is known by many names. Some know him only as the Grey Pilgrim, while others call bim Stormcrow, or Greyhame. Though he looks old and stooped, bis gaze can unsettle those who are not used to the wise wizard, giving them the sense that he knows more than he ought, and sees things they might prefer to hide. Gandalf has powers at his command that are beyond what mortals can wield, for be is of the Istari. As a member of the White Council, Gandalf is chiefy concerned with keeping the forces of corruption and shadow at bay. He knows what could come to pass ijf the Council falters.
cards.background_ru: Гэндальф известен под многими именами. Некоторые знают его лишь как Серого Странника, в то время как другие называют его Горевестником или Серой Хламидой. Несмотря на то что он выглядит старым и сгорбленным, его взгляд может смутить тех, кто не привык к мудрым волшебникам. Таким людям кажется, что волшебники знают больше, чем должны, и видят то, что от них предпочитают скрывать. Гэндальф владеет силами, которые неподвластны простым смертным, ибо он из истари. Он состоит в Белом совете и в первую очередь заботится о том, чтобы держать силы Тьмы и порчи в узде. Он знает, что может случиться, если Совет дрогнет.

cards.background_en: Gimli, son of Gloin, descendant of Durin the Deathless, long burned for adventure beyond his exile-home in Ered Luin. When Gloin joined a company traveling east to reclaim the forfeited Kingdom under the Mountain, Gimli could not join their number. Now, however, being of a respectable age, Gimli is ready to release his ferocity and expertise upon his foes. Like any Dwarf, a passion churns within to deliver retribution on the vile Ores that dwell in the darkness beneath the earth. One need not travel below to find them now, however, and so Gimli waits, restless, for the first call for deliverance from, or war against, the rising darkness.

cards.background_en: Where many Elves of Mirkwood are skilled, Legolas excels: with bow and blade, perceiving what others cannot and moving without impediment or trace. Nevertheless, as son to the king of the Woodland Realm, much of Legolas life is overshadowed by the grandeur of bis father, even as the kingdom shrinks before the darkness in the South. Where once the borders of Mirkwood were revered, now Orcs, Dwarves, and even stranger folk called Hobbits travel. The world is in motion, fueled by a spreading darkness. Whether at home or abroad, Legolas stands ready to lend his superior talent and skill in the fight against the rising evil.
cards.background_ru: В тех вопросах, где большинство эльфов Лихолесья считаются мастерами, Леголас их намного превосходит. Он отлично владеет луком и клинком, способен замечать то, что другим недоступно, и ловко перемещается, не оставляя следов. Тем не менее большая часть жизни Леголаса проходила в тени величия его отца, правителя Лесного Королевства, даже когда над их владениями нависла угроза от Тьмы с юга. Там, где когда-то проходили границы Лихолесья, всё чаще стали замечать орков, гномов и даже странный народ, называемый хоббитами. Весь мир постепенно приходит в движение, подпитываемый разрастающейся Тьмой. Но неважно, где Леголас находится: в родных землях или за их пределами, — он готов использовать свои великолепные таланты и навыки в борьбе с растущим злом.

cards.background_en: "Being clever is often better than being migbty" is a piece of advice oft repeated by Cirdan, the. shipwright of the Elves. In his daughter Renerien, those words have proven to be a great truth. Renerien is as inventive as any shipwright, but she is not content to stay at port. She bas seen many of her kin travel to the West, and knows that she has much she wants to accomplish before taking that journey herself. Joy lights her eyes, even when the shadow of cruelty and war darken the lands through which she travels, because she knows that there are often solutions bidden in the most tangled of wrecks for those brave and clever enough to find them. If you pass, your captors are terrifying, but too slow to stop your escape. Suffer 1 facedown fear. Then place your figure in any explored space and discard this bane.
